boolean.grammar:
answer ::= "\"" char{0,300} "\""
answer-kv ::= "\"answer\"" space ":" space answer
boolean ::= ("true" | "false")
char ::= [^"\\\x7F\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
found ::= boolean | null
found-kv ::= "\"found\"" space ":" space found
null ::= "null"
root ::= "{" space found-kv "," space answer-kv space "}"
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}

count.grammar:
answer ::= "\"" char{0,300} "\""
answer-kv ::= "\"answer\"" space ":" space answer
char ::= [^"\\\x7F\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
count ::= count-0 | null
count-0 ::= ([0] | [1-9] [0-9]{0,15})
count-kv ::= "\"count\"" space ":" space count
null ::= "null"
root ::= "{" space count-kv "," space answer-kv space "}"
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}
